theme: One open day before tomorrow's Brunswick call
greeting: The whole day is clear, Dan — not a single meeting. The open hours are best spent arriving ready for tomorrow's 11 AM with Brunswick.

needsAttention.title: Get ready for the Brunswick call
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow at 11 AM ET you meet Erika Maass, who leads senior recruitment at Brunswick and already has your resume. Today's open hours are the moment to land on what you want and why Brunswick.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: The full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week sells out early. Book it refundable now and fix the dates later — it's already past the date you set yourself.

flagged.title: Shawn Maher wrote back
flagged.detail: He named his EY successor, Didem Nisanci, as a useful contact — a warm networking thread worth keeping alive.

flagged.title: New public-policy role alert
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn alert surfaced an SVP, Global Public Policy opening and similar roles.

inbox.noise: LinkedIn invites and a few newsletters and promos — nothing needing you.
inbox.clear: The Maine Visionaries ask and the Brunswick scheduling are both handled.

resolved.title: Maine Visionaries ask, said yes
resolved.detail: You replied to Ellen Richstone agreeing to help recruit directors for the NACD NE program.

resolved.title: Brunswick call set for Wednesday
resolved.detail: You and Erika settled on 11 AM ET and it's on the calendar.
